title: A2v10 metadata.json (ledger)
description: Postings against one chart of accounts: ledger/<name>/metadata.json. Written only by 'post' of documents, in mirrored legs - a debit row and a credit row, each carrying the other's account in CorrAcc. The baseline (Id, Date, InOut, Acc, CorrAcc, Sum) is the platform's and is not written here; the provenance (a column of type 'document', and 'operation', 'row' where needed) is declared in 'fields', as in a journal.

description.description: For the model, not the platform: nothing reads it - no generator, runtime or deploy. Where the model writes down what it must know about this endpoint - its rules and the reasons for them - so the next session finds them here.

table.description: The SQL table of this ledger, in schema 'led'. No default - a table name is never derived from the folder name.

model.description: Base of the generated names. Defaults to the folder name in PascalCase.

accplan.description: The chart this ledger posts against, e.g. '/accplan/national': the target of Acc and CorrAcc. Required, no default - the folder name of the ledger says nothing about its chart. A path that is not a chart of accounts is refused at load. One chart per ledger.

fields.description: Provenance, analytics and measures. A column of type 'document' is required (unpost and the transactions dialog find the rows by it); 'operation' and 'row' are found by type as well. Analytics are nullable and sparse - each leg fills its own.
